***The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] carry out six [[airstrike]]s on [[Hudaydah Port]] in [[Hodeidah]], [[Houthi-controlled territory of Yemen|Houthi-controlled Yemen]], in response to yesterday's [[2025 Houthi attack on Tel Aviv airport|attack]] on [[Ben Gurion Airport]] in [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]]. **The [[Israel]] [[Security Cabinet of Israel|Security Cabinet]] confirms they plan to [[Israeli occupation of the Gaza Strip|control more than 70%]] of the [[Gaza Strip]] indefinitely, alongside moving its [[Gazans|civilians]] southwards. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/05/israel-expand-military-operations-gaza (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]], [[Sudan–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[International Court of Justice]] dismisses [[Sudan]]'s case against the [[United Arab Emirates]] (UAE) alleging that the UAE violated the [[Genocide Convention]] by [[arms trafficking|supplying weapons]] to the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and other paramilitary groups in the [[Darfur region]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/icj-dismisses-sudan-genocide-case-against-uae/a-72440652 (DW)] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/the-uns-top-court-dismisses-sudans-genocide-case-alleging-uae-funded-rebel-paramilitaries (PBS)]
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**Five [[Palestinian nationalism|pro-Palestinian]] protesters are arrested by [[National Police Corps (Netherlands)|police]] during a [[World War II]] anniversary event in [[Wageningen]], [[Netherlands]], after throwing a [[smoke bomb]] onto the stage during a speech by [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Dutch prime minister]] [[Dick Schoof]] while [[Poland|Polish]] [[Prime Minister of Poland|prime minister]] [[Donald Tusk]] was visiting, and holding up [[banner]]s and flags. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/dutch-police-arrest-pro-palestine-protesters-world-war-two-anniversary-event-2025-05-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**Three people are killed and five are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Glendale, Arizona|Glendale]], [[Arizona]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/9-injured-glendale-arizona-shooting-police/story?id=121460049 (ABC News)]
*Three traffic police officers and two gunmen are killed and at least four others, including a police officer and two other shooters, are injured in a [[mass shooting]] and [[shootout]] by gunmen in [[Makhachkala]], [[Dagestan]], Russia. One of the attackers fled in a police car. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-police-officers-killed-russias-dagestan-2025-05-05/ (Reuters)]

**[[2025 Australian Senate election]]
***The incumbent [[Australia]]n [[Australian Labor Party|Labor Party]] overtakes the [[Coalition (Australia)|Liberal–National Coalition]] as the largest [[Plurality (voting)|plurality]] in the [[Australian Senate|Senate]], meaning support will be required only from the Coalition or the [[Australian Greens]] to pass legislation.
